observations: White industrial sewing machine with a digital control panel.
Brand 'EMEL' is visible on the front of the machine in photo 0, 1, and 3.
The machine is mounted on a white metal table with a red foot pedal.
A multi-spindle bobbin case is attached to the right side of the machine.
The machine is shown in a showroom or workshop environment.
No accessories, original manual, or power cord are visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show the machine in good cosmetic condition, but usage history cannot be confirmed.
The machine is shown with a foot pedal and a multi-spindle bobbin case, which are characteristic of direct drive models.
No photo shows the machine powered on or running; it appears to be in a showroom state.
The photos show the exterior, but internal mechanical condition and functionality are unknown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have a faulty motor.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through all stitch cycles.

risks.risk: The digital display may be cracked or non-functional.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the LCD screen while the machine is powered on.

risks.risk: The foot pedal may be stiff or broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the pedal being pressed and released.

risks.risk: The bobbin case may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the bobbin case and the underside of the machine.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and running through all stitch cycles.
Photo of the LCD screen while the machine is running.
Photo of the bobbin case and the underside of the machine.
Photo of the power cord and any included accessories.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
